purpose: Teach: 門真/三谷/上村/奥山/二宮/坂田/西岡/西山

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 門真工場の月次報告を確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's review the Kadoma factory monthly report.
lines.style: Crisp, matter-of-fact opening. Professional pace, no hesitation. The tone of someone running through a checklist with quiet efficiency.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。三谷部長の歓迎会を準備します
lines.en: Yes. I'll get the welcome reception for Director Mitani organized.
lines.style: Straightforward acknowledgment with a slight upbeat lilt on the task. Ready, attentive. The efficiency of someone who's already mentally moved to the next item.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 上村課長の引き継ぎ書を確認しましょう
lines.style: Even tone, directive but not demanding. Steady pace. The rhythm of someone moving through a prepared agenda.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。奥山技術主任のプロジェクト進捗を共有します
lines.en: Yes. I'll share Okuyama's technical project status update.
lines.style: Prompt, capable. A small nod in the voice—confirming he's tracking and moving ahead. Even pacing, professional.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 二宮広報の月次企画書を確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's check Ninomiya's PR monthly planning proposal.
lines.style: Consistent directional tone. Controlled pace. The voice of someone keeping the meeting structured and on time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。坂田経理の決算予定を整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll finalize Sakata's financial closing schedule.
lines.style: Brief, assured. The confidence of someone who knows what they're doing and saying it once. Clear enunciation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 西岡人事に新人研修プランを依頼しましょう
lines.en: Let's reach out to Nishioka in HR about the new hire training plan.
lines.style: Directive but collaborative—not commanding. Measured pace. A task assigned with the assumption of smooth execution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。西山法務に新契約レビューを依頼します
lines.en: Yes. I'll request the new contract review from the legal team.
lines.style: Crisp close. Quick but complete. The finality of the last item on the list. Professional, done.
